# Feedback API

> Collect, manage, and analyze user feedback. REST API with filtering, pagination, and summary statistics.

## Endpoints

- GET /api/feedback — List feedback with filtering (category, rating, tag, author, sort, limit, offset)
- POST /api/feedback — Create feedback entry (requires Bearer token)
- GET /api/feedback/{id} — Get single feedback by ID
- PATCH /api/feedback/{id} — Update feedback (requires Bearer token)
- DELETE /api/feedback/{id} — Delete feedback (requires Bearer token)
- GET /api/feedback/summary — Aggregate stats (total, avg rating, distribution, categories, top tags)

## Auth

Write ops require `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Reads are public.
